compiled_state.description:
Testing mode: GREEN

Implement plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/check-ruleset-preflight.sh to make tests in tests/scripts/test-check-ruleset-preflight.sh pass.

Script requirements:
- Must be executable (chmod +x)
- Usage: check-ruleset-preflight.sh [--repo <owner/repo>] [--config <path-to-dso-config.conf>]
- Reads dso.review.check_name from dso-config.conf (default: look for .claude/dso-config.conf relative to repo root; fall back to 'Sprint Story Review' if key absent)
- Uses read-only gh API calls only (no admin permissions required at runtime)
- Calls gh api GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/rulesets to list all rulesets
- Validates three conditions for at least one ruleset:
  (a) conditions.ref_name.include contains a pattern matching 'session-*' (refs/heads/session/* or session/*)
  (b) required_status_checks rule exists and its required_status_checks array contains context matching dso.review.check_name
  (c) linear_history rule does NOT appear (or required_linear_history=false equivalent)
- On any validation failure: print actionable error message to stderr, print link to INSTALL.md#github-rulesets-for-session-branches, exit 1
- On success: exit 0 silently (or with a short confirmation message)
- Dependencies: gh CLI, jq (both required; exit 1 with message if missing)
- Use mktemp for any temp files; use set -euo pipefail

Script location: plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/check-ruleset-preflight.sh
